mapper.select: SELECT e.*,e.filter_snapshot->>'scope' AS export_scope, j.id AS run_id,j.status AS run_status,j.processed_count FROM export_job e LEFT JOIN job_run j ON j.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND j.job_type='GENERATE_PERSONAL_EXPORT' AND j.batch_key=e.id::text WHERE e.id=#{p.id} AND e.user_id=#{p.userId}
SELECT user_id,filter_snapshot::text,expires_at,status,file_location FROM export_job WHERE id=#{p.id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_job SET status='RUNNING',error_summary=NULL,updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at>#{p.now}
UPDATE export_job SET status='SUCCEEDED',file_location=#{p.location},error_summary=NULL,updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='RUNNING' AND expires_at>#{p.now}
UPDATE export_job SET status='FAILED',file_location=NULL,error_summary=#{p.summary},updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE export_job SET status='CANCELLED',file_location=NULL,error_summary=NULL,updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
UPDATE export_job SET status='EXPIRED',file_location=NULL,error_summary=NULL,updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status<>'EXPIRED' AND expires_at<=#{p.now}
